parts.name: brow frame

physics.Basic_description: Dark brown curved strip forming the top rim of the glasses frame.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support for the top of the lens and connects the temples.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the top center rim with a parallel jaw gripper.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic frame component is solid throughout its small cross-section.

parts.description: Dark brown curved strip forming the top rim of the glasses frame.

parts.name: hinge block right

physics.Basic_description: Small rectangular block at the right corner connecting the frame to the temple.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the hinge mechanism for the right temple arm.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp reliably; avoid.
physics.reason: Small structural block is solid plastic.

parts.name: nose stem right

physics.Functional_description: Supports and positions the right nose pad.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and fragile to grasp.
physics.reason: Thin rod structure is solid material.

parts.description: Thin wire-like stem extending down from the frame to hold the nose pad.

parts.name: shield lens

physics.Basic_description: Large, curved, semi-transparent brown tinted panel covering the front.
physics.Functional_description: Protects eyes and provides vision filtering.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the bottom edge or side of the lens carefully to avoid smudging.
physics.reason: Lens is a thin sheet but modeled as solid material volume (approx 2mm thick).

parts.description: Large, curved, semi-transparent brown tinted panel covering the front.
parts.function: Protects eyes and provides vision filtering.

parts.name: arm right

physics.Basic_description: Long, thin brown arm extending backwards from the right hinge.
physics.Functional_description: Extends over the ear to hold the glasses in place.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the mid-section of the arm with a parallel gripper.
physics.reason: Temple arm is a solid extrusion or molding.

parts.description: Long, thin brown arm extending backwards from the right hinge.
parts.function: Extends over the ear to hold the glasses in place.

parts.name: ear tip right

physics.Basic_description: Soft, slightly thicker sleeve at the end of the right temple arm.
physics.Functional_description: Provides friction and comfort behind the ear.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the tip of the arm; high friction aids grip.
physics.reason: Ear tips are often sleeves slipped over the plastic arm core.

parts.description: Soft, slightly thicker sleeve at the end of the right temple arm.

parts.name: knuckle right

physics.Basic_description: Small joint component at the start of the right temple arm.
physics.Functional_description: Allows rotation of the temple arm relative to the frame.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and close to the hinge to grasp safely.
physics.reason: Small mechanical joint part is solid.

parts.description: Small joint component at the start of the right temple arm.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
